add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.title: Add Text at Specific Coordinates to a PDF Page
add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a TextFragment, positioning it using X/Y coordinates, adding it to the first page, and saving the result.

insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.title: Insert Identical Plain Text on All PDF Pages
insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, adds the same plain text via a TextFragment to the page's Paragraphs collection, and saves the modified document.

load-custom-ttf-font-and-apply-to-text.title: Apply Custom TrueType Font to PDF Text
load-custom-ttf-font-and-apply-to-text.description: Demonstrates how to register a custom TrueType font with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve it, and assign it to a TextFragment's TextState for rendering in a PDF document.

apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.title: Apply Custom OpenType Font to a TextFragment
apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.description: Demonstrates how to register an OTF font with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextFragment, apply the custom font and styling, and save the result as a PDF.

set-character-spacing-pdf.title: Add Text with Custom Character Spacing
set-character-spacing-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a TextFragment, sets the CharacterSpacing property on its TextState to increase inter‑character gaps, positions the fragment on the first page, and saves the modified document.

left-align-text-pdf.title: Add Left-Aligned Text to PDF
left-align-text-pdf.description: Demonstrates adding a text fragment to a PDF page and aligning it to the left margin using Aspose.Pdf.

center-text-horizontally-in-pdf.title: Center Text Horizontally in PDF
center-text-horizontally-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its TextState.HorizontalAlignment to Center, and save the updated document.

right-align-text-in-pdf.title: Right‑Align Text on a PDF Page
right-align-text-in-pdf.description: Shows how to right‑align a text fragment on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf by setting the TextState.HorizontalAlignment property.

add-multi-line-text-paragraph.title: Add Multi‑Line Text to PDF
add-multi-line-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF document, adding a page, inserting a multi‑line TextFragment with custom font, size, color, and line spacing, and saving the file.

insert-hyperlink-into-pdf-text-segment.title: Insert Clickable Hyperlink into PDF
insert-hyperlink-into-pdf-text-segment.description: Shows how to add a clickable hyperlink to a PDF by creating a TextSegment and attaching a LinkAnnotation with a GoToURIAction.

add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.title: Add Styled HTML Fragment to PDF
add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a styled HTML fragment into a PDF page using HtmlFragment and customize its appearance with TextState.

add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.title: Add Footnote with Image to PDF Page
add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a footnote on a PDF page and insert an image into the page's Paragraphs collection using Aspose.Pdf.

add-table-to-pdf-footnote.title: Add Table to Footnote in a Tagged PDF
add-table-to-pdf-footnote.description: Demonstrates how to create a footnote (NoteElement) in a tagged PDF and populate it with a table using Aspose.Pdf's logical structure API.

add-endnote-bold-italic.title: Add Endnote with Bold and Italic Styling to PDF
add-endnote-bold-italic.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, optionally extracting its text, adding a new page, creating a TextFragment for an endnote, applying bold and italic formatting via TextState, positioning it, and saving the document.

inline-text-image-paragraph.title: Add Inline Image to Text Paragraph
inline-text-image-paragraph.description: Shows how to combine a TextFragment and an Image fragment inline within a single paragraph to create a mixed text‑image element in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.title: Add Invisible Tooltip Button Over Specific Text
add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.description: Demonstrates locating a target string in a PDF with TextFragmentAbsorber, then overlaying an invisible ButtonField on that text and assigning a tooltip via the AlternateName property and a JavaScript OnEnter action.

find-phrase-occurrences-with-textabsorbe.title: Find Specific Phrase in PDF Using TextFragmentAbsorber
find-phrase-occurrences-with-textabsorbe.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber to locate each occurrence of a given phrase in a PDF, outputting the page number and the fragment's coordinates.

replace-phrase-preserve-formatting.title: Replace Text in PDF While Preserving Formatting
replace-phrase-preserve-formatting.description: Shows how to locate specific phrases in a PDF and replace them with new text using Aspose.Pdf, while keeping the original font, size, color, and other formatting.

add-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header to All PDF Pages
add-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF document's pages and insert a text header on each page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Footer with Page Numbers to PDF
add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a footer containing page numbers on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment and positioning APIs.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent text watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp and TextState.

rotate-added-text-in-pdf.title: Rotate Text in a PDF Document
rotate-added-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a text fragment to a PDF page and rotate it by specifying an angle via the TextState.Rotation property.

apply-background-color-to-text.title: Apply Background Color to Text in PDF
apply-background-color-to-text.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a TextFragment, sets its TextState.BackgroundColor to Yellow, and saves the file.

set-font-size-color-textfragment.title: Set Font Size and Color for TextFragment
set-font-size-color-textfragment.description: Demonstrates how to style a TextFragment by configuring its TextState properties (FontSize, ForegroundColor, Font) and adding it to a PDF page.

add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.title: Add Text to PDF from Memory Stream
add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.description: Shows how to create a PDF in memory, load it from a MemoryStream, insert a TextFragment, and save the modified PDF back to a stream.

convert-modified-pdf-to-byte-array.title: Save Modified PDF to Byte Array
convert-modified-pdf-to-byte-array.description: The example loads a PDF, adds a text annotation, and saves the modified document into a byte array using a MemoryStream for further processing or transmission.

add-text-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Add Text and Encrypt PDF with Password
add-text-and-encrypt-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, adds a text fragment to the first page, then encrypts the document with user and owner passwords using AES‑256 and saves it.

add-underlined-text-to-pdf.title: Add Underlined Text to PDF
add-underlined-text-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a TextFragment, enables underline via TextState, and inserts the fragment onto the first page before saving.

create-strikethrough-text-pdf.title: Create Strikethrough Text in a PDF
create-strikethrough-text-pdf.description: Shows how to apply a strikethrough (strikeout) style to text by setting TextState.StrikeOut and adding a TextFragment to a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf.

render-superscript-text.title: Create Superscript Text in PDF
render-superscript-text.description: Shows how to add normal and superscript text to a PDF using TextFragment objects, adjusting font size and positioning the superscript above the baseline.

render-subscript-text.title: Render Subscript Text in PDF
render-subscript-text.description: Shows how to add subscript characters to an existing PDF by creating TextFragment objects with a smaller font size and adjusted position (or rise) before saving the document.

set-custom-line-spacing-pdf.title: Set Line Spacing for Added Text in PDF
set-custom-line-spacing-pdf.description: Shows how to add a multi‑line text fragment to a PDF and control its line spacing by setting the TextState.LineSpacing (Leading) property.

adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.title: Insert Text with Custom Word Spacing into PDF
adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.description: Shows how to add a TextFragment to a PDF page and adjust the spacing between words using the TextState.WordSpacing property.

justify-text-in-pdf.title: Justify Text in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
justify-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a paragraph, and set its horizontal alignment to Justify using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment and TextState.

add-arabic-bidi-text-to-pdf.title: Add Bidirectional Text to PDF using Aspose.PDF
add-arabic-bidi-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert mixed left‑to‑right and right‑to‑left Unicode text (e.g., English, Arabic, Hebrew) into a PDF by creating a TextFragment, setting a Unicode font, and saving the document.

set-custom-line-height-pdf-text.title: Set Custom Line Height for PDF Text
set-custom-line-height-pdf-text.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a multi‑line TextFragment, sets a custom line height (line spacing) via TextState, adds it to the first page, and saves the result.

emulate-kerning-in-pdf-text.title: Add Text Fragment with Kerning Approximation to PDF
emulate-kerning-in-pdf-text.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a TextFragment, adjusting character spacing to simulate kerning, setting font properties, and saving the modified document.

render-text-with-ligatures.title: Generate PDF with Ligatures Using Aspose.Pdf
render-text-with-ligatures.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a TextFragment containing characters that can form ligatures, setting font and size, and saving the document. Highlights that ligatures are handled automatically by Aspose.Pdf.

enable-hyphenation-long-words-pdf.title: Enable Automatic Hyphenation for Long Words in PDF
enable-hyphenation-long-words-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF, creating a TextFragment with a long word, configuring its TextState (including hyphenation when supported), adding it to a page, and saving the modified document.

embed-css-in-htmlfragment.title: Embed CSS in HtmlFragment for Styled PDF
embed-css-in-htmlfragment.description: Shows how to embed CSS rules inside an HtmlFragment to control font, color, and spacing when converting HTML to PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

create-text-link-goto-action.title: Create GoTo Link Between PDF Pages
create-text-link-goto-action.description: Shows how to add a TextFragment and a LinkAnnotation with a GoToAction to navigate from one page to another in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-clickable-hyperlink-text-to-pdf.title: Add Clickable Text Link to PDF
add-clickable-hyperlink-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a styled text fragment into a PDF and attach a URI link annotation so the text becomes clickable.

create-pdf-launch-action-open-external-f.title: Add Launch Action to PDF Text to Open External File
create-pdf-launch-action-open-external-f.description: Demonstrates how to add a clickable text element in a PDF that launches an external file using a LaunchAction annotation.

rotate-specific-text-fragment.title: Rotate Specific Text Fragment in PDF
rotate-specific-text-fragment.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate a given text string with TextFragmentAbsorber, and add a new TextFragment rotated by 45 degrees at the same position.

insert-rotated-text-second-page.title: Insert Rotated Text on Second PDF Page
insert-rotated-text-second-page.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, checking for a second page, creating a TextFragment with rotation, and inserting it using TextBuilder.

create-rotated-text-paragraph.title: Create Rotated Text Paragraph with Multiple Segments
create-rotated-text-paragraph.description: Shows how to build a TextFragment containing several TextSegments, set its position, apply a 30‑degree rotation, and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-confidential-with-public-in-pdf.title: Replace "Confidential" with "Public" in a PDF
replace-confidential-with-public-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to search for a specific phrase in a PDF and replace it with another using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber and Document.Save.

extract-email-addresses-from-pdf.title: Extract Email Addresses from Each PDF Page
extract-email-addresses-from-pdf.description: Shows how to extract text from every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, apply a regular expression to locate email addresses, and store the results per page.

detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.title: Detect Line Breaks in TextFragment Segments
detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.description: Loads a PDF, adds a multi‑line TextFragment, iterates over its TextSegments to identify line‑break characters, and saves the modified document.

extract-text-fragments-and-positions.title: Retrieve Line Break Information from PDF Text Fragments
extract-text-fragments-and-positions.description: Shows how to load a PDF, extract all text fragments and obtain line‑break details using the GetLineBreakInfo method (with a reflection fallback).

append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.title: Append Disclaimer Text to First PDF Page
append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment with a disclaimer, append it to the first page's paragraph collection, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-header-text-pdf.title: Rotate PDF Header Text by 90 Degrees
rotate-header-text-pdf.description: The example loops through all PDF files in a folder, detects header‑like text fragments by font size, rotates those fragments 90° clockwise, and saves the updated PDFs.

replace-text-rotate-page-save-memory-str.title: Replace Text and Rotate PDF Pages, Save to MemoryStream
replace-text-rotate-page-save-memory-str.description: The example loads a PDF, replaces all occurrences of a specified string with new text, rotates each page 90 degrees clockwise, and saves the modified document into a MemoryStream.

search-text-pdf-with-logging.title: Enable Logging and Search Text in a PDF
search-text-pdf-with-logging.description: The example shows how to enable simple file logging, search for a term in a PDF using TextFragmentAbsorber, highlight the matches, save the modified document, and verify that the search action was recorded in the log.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save as UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all page text using TextAbsorber, and write the concatenated result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-line-break-positions-from-pdf.title: Extract Line Break Y Positions from a PDF TextFragment
extract-line-break-positions-from-pdf.description: The example creates a PDF with a multi‑line TextFragment, iterates over its TextSegments to obtain the lower‑left Y coordinate of each line, and saves these positions to a JSON file.

add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp and TextState to place a semi‑transparent, rotated watermark on every page of a PDF document.

replace-text-on-specific-pdf-pages.title: Replace Text on Specific PDF Pages
replace-text-on-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to replace a given string only within a defined page range of a PDF by iterating pages and using TextFragmentAbsorber.

highlight-keyword-occurrences-pdf.title: Case‑Insensitive Keyword Highlight in PDF
highlight-keyword-occurrences-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, searches for a keyword without regard to case, and highlights each occurrence with a yellow background using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-rotated-mixed-style-text-paragrap.title: Add Mixed-Style Rotated Text to PDF Page
insert-rotated-mixed-style-text-paragrap.description: Shows how to create a TextFragment with bold, italic and regular segments, apply a 45° rotation, and insert it onto the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-replace-multiple-strings-in-pdf.title: Batch Replace Multiple Strings in PDFs
batch-replace-multiple-strings-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files and replace several specified strings with new values using Aspose.Pdf's text extraction and replacement capabilities.

extract-page-word-count-to-csv.title: Extract Text and Count Words per PDF Page
extract-page-word-count-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from each page of a PDF, count the words on that page, and write the page number and word count to a CSV file using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-draft-text-fragments.title: Rotate 'Draft' Text Fragments in PDF
rotate-draft-text-fragments.description: Shows how to locate all text fragments containing the word "Draft" in a PDF and apply a 15‑degree rotation to each fragment using Aspose.Pdf.

find-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.title: Find MM/DD/YYYY Dates in PDF Using Regex
find-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.description: Demonstrates how to search a PDF for dates in the MM/DD/YYYY format using a regular‑expression pattern with Aspose.Pdf's text‑search APIs.

rotate-table-cell-text.title: Rotate Text Inside a Table Cell
rotate-table-cell-text.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a TextFragment by 60 degrees and place it inside a table cell, updating the PDF layout accordingly.

rotate-pdf-title-text-45-degrees.title: Rotate PDF Title Text by 45 Degrees
rotate-pdf-title-text-45-degrees.description: Shows how to read a PDF's title metadata, find matching text fragments, rotate them 45 degrees, and save the updated PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-text-bottom-right-last-page.title: Add Rotated Text to Bottom‑Right Corner of Last PDF Page
add-rotated-text-bottom-right-last-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextBuilder to place a rotated text fragment at the bottom‑right corner of the last page of a PDF document.

replace-text-with-clickable-hyperlink.title: Add Clickable Hyperlink to Text in PDF
replace-text-with-clickable-hyperlink.description: Searches for a specific phrase in a PDF and replaces it with a styled, clickable hyperlink using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-text-sentences-per-page.title: Split PDF Text into Sentences and Write Each to a New Page
extract-pdf-text-sentences-per-page.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts its full text using TextAbsorber, splits the text into individual sentences, and creates a new PDF where each sentence is placed on its own page as a TextFragment.

batch-replace-keywords-in-pdf.title: Batch Replace Text in PDF Using JSON Configuration
batch-replace-keywords-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, reading a JSON map of old‑to‑new strings, and replacing all occurrences of each keyword across all pages using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf-using-fuzzy-regex.title: Fuzzy Text Search in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
replace-text-in-pdf-using-fuzzy-regex.description: Demonstrates how to perform a fuzzy (approximate) text search in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber and TextSearchOptions, and writes the locations of matches to a text file.

show-popup-on-button-mouse-enter.title: Show Popup on Button Mouse Enter
show-popup-on-button-mouse-enter.description: Demonstrates creating a popup annotation and assigning a HideAction to a button's OnEnter event so the floating box appears when the mouse enters the button.

add-arabic-rtl-text-to-pdf.title: Add Arabic RTL Text to PDF
add-arabic-rtl-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create a TextFragment with Arabic characters, set a Unicode font and right‑to‑left direction, and save the updated document.

add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Page
add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF, creates a text annotation with title, contents and icon, adds it to the first page, and saves the modified document.

add-semi-transparent-text-to-pdf.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text to a PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set text opacity by configuring the TextState's color with an alpha component and adding the TextFragment to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

append-multiline-textfragment-line-break.title: Append Multi‑Line TextFragment and Retrieve Line Breaks
append-multiline-textfragment-line-break.description: Loads a PDF, appends a multi‑line TextFragment to the first page, and shows how to extract line‑break information from the original text for custom rendering.
